content: Unlike the aforementioned generative model, the Bi-Directional Attention Flow (BiDAF) BIBREF23 network learns to directly predict the answer span in the context. BiDAF first utilizes multi-level embedding layers to encode both the question and context, then uses bi-directional attention flow to get a query-aware context representation, which is further modeled by an RNN layer to make the span predictions. Since our TweetQA does not have labeled answer spans as in SQuAD, we need to use the human-written answers to retrieve the answer-span labels for training. To get the approximate answer spans, we consider the same matching approach as in the query matching baseline. But instead of using questions to do matching, we use the human-written answers to get the spans that achieve the best BLEU-1 scores.
